## mcrl channel create

Create a channel.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl channel create [flags]

Aliases:
  create, new

Create a channel from flags, or from a JSON or YAML file in the API's format
with -f. Flags override the file's fields.

API: POST /api/v0/channels
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl channel create --type slack --name ops --url https://hooks.slack.com/services/... --mention critical='<!channel>' --event alert
  mcrl channel create --type email --name oncall --email oncall@example.com --event alert --event hostRetire

Flags:
      --add-to-default-group   add to the default notification group (create only)
      --email stringArray      email address (email channels, repeatable)
      --event stringArray      events to notify (repeatable): alert, alertGroup, hostStatus, hostRegister, hostRetire, monitor
  -f, --file string            JSON or YAML file in the API's format ("-" for stdin)
      --graph-image            attach graph images (slack, webhook)
      --mention stringArray    Slack mention per status as status=text, e.g. "critical=<!channel>" (repeatable)
      --name string            name
      --type string            email, slack or webhook (create only)
      --url string             Slack incoming webhook URL or webhook URL
      --user stringArray       organization member ID (email channels, repeatable)
```

## mcrl channel delete

Delete a channel.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl channel delete <channel>

Aliases:
  delete, rm

Delete a channel. The output is the deleted object.

API: DELETE /api/v0/channels/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl channel delete ops
  mcrl channel delete 2wvKpqFzgD9 --yes
```

## mcrl channel edit

Edit a channel in $EDITOR.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl channel edit <channel>

Open the current channel as YAML in $VISUAL or $EDITOR (default vi), then
show the changes and send them after confirmation.

The whole object is sent back, including fields mcrl does not know about,
so nothing is lost. Read-only fields (id, suspendedAt) are hidden. If the file does not
parse, the editor opens again with the error at the top. Saving an empty file
or leaving it unchanged cancels.

API: PUT /api/v0/channels/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl channel edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
  EDITOR='code --wait' mcrl channel edit 3Ja1bAxcdef
```

## mcrl channel get

Show a channel.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl channel get <channel>

Aliases:
  get, show

Show a channel by ID or name.

A reference that looks like an ID (11 alphanumeric characters) is looked up
as an ID first. Prefix it with "id:" or "name:" to force either.

API: GET /api/v0/channels
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl channel get ops-slack
  mcrl channel get 2wvKpqFzgD9
```

## mcrl channel list

List notification channels.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl channel list

Aliases:
  list, ls

List notification channels.

API: GET /api/v0/channels
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl channel list
  mcrl channel list --jq '.[] | select(.type == "slack") | .name'
```

## mcrl channel update

Update a channel.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl channel update <channel> [flags]

Update a channel. The current channel is fetched and the flags (and -f fields) are
applied on top, so only the fields to change need to be given. --replace
sends the -f file as the complete object instead.

API: PUT /api/v0/channels/<id>
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl channel update ops --event alert --event alertGroup
  mcrl channel update ops --graph-image

Flags:
      --add-to-default-group   add to the default notification group (create only)
      --email stringArray      email address (email channels, repeatable)
      --event stringArray      events to notify (repeatable): alert, alertGroup, hostStatus, hostRegister, hostRetire, monitor
  -f, --file string            JSON or YAML file with the fields to change ("-" for stdin)
      --graph-image            attach graph images (slack, webhook)
      --mention stringArray    Slack mention per status as status=text, e.g. "critical=<!channel>" (repeatable)
      --name string            name
      --replace                send the -f file as the complete object without merging
      --type string            email, slack or webhook (create only)
      --url string             Slack incoming webhook URL or webhook URL
      --user stringArray       organization member ID (email channels, repeatable)
```
